title: Made a Godot plugin so AI agents (and you) can find assets by what they look like
author: codecustard
selftext:
AI coding agents are pretty bad at picking assets. They can only go by file names, so in a messy project (IMG\_4821.png, random pack naming) they either guess or open image after image, which burns a lot of tokens.



So I made Rummage. It indexes your project's textures and 3D models locally, and you search by description: "rusty metal", "wooden chair". It works in the Godot editor, and it has an MCP server so Claude Code, Cursor etc. can use the same search.



I tested it with Claude Code on a sample project where every asset file was renamed IMG\_xxxx, same 15 tasks (find a texture, give a mesh a material, place a model), 3 runs each:

\- with Rummage: right asset 98-100% of the time

\- without: 69% (Sonnet 5.5) / 89% (Opus 5.5)

\- without used \~3x the tokens and \~4-5x the API cost



For people it also does one-click materials from texture sets, drag models into the scene, and find similar. Runs locally, nothing uploaded.



It'll be a paid plugin, beta soon. Waitlist in the comments. Would love to hear how you're handling assets with agents right now.
